g.title: Kratos::PowerIterationEigenvalueSolver< TSparseSpaceType, TDenseSpaceType, TLinearSolverType, TPreconditionerType, TReordererType >

a.xlink:title: This class uses the inverted power iteration method to obtain the lowest eigenvalue of a system.
Base class for all the iterative solvers in Kratos.
